historical_claims.anchor: Jordan was born in Lyon in 1838, into a family in which public service, engineering, and the arts were all familiar occupations
Their household eventually included eight children
Jordan attended the Collège d'Oullins and the Lycée de Lyon before passing the entrance examination
Jordan's father later entered the National Assembly, serving during the early years of the Third Republic.
